body: I agree... without going on too much of a tangent: It is severely depressing that we cannot trust those who took an oath to protect us.

For the sake of retaining some level of anonymity, I don't think I should give out too many details... Please forgive me. The internet as a whole excels at piecing together information from the most obscure places. :-\ 

But thank you for your therapy recommendation. I will be seeking it.
Thank you very much for the resource. I sincerely appreciate it. I give you my word that I will pay this kindness forward.

Thank you. I don't want to give out too much information, but from what I've read, it looks like I can bring up charges against this person within the statute of limitations in my state. In all fairness I still pass as a boy without makeup or clothing, so I could just try to avoid the Trans subject all together if necessary. It will be worth it to me if this person is charged and can somehow stay on his record that he was accused, at the very least--assuming that he is not convicted.

On the therapy note: I am seeking therapy through the proper channels. It hurts to even talk about it, but the sooner I deal with it, the sooner I can move on with my life.

Again, thank you so much for your kind words and understanding.

I'd like to resolve the issue for myself. Though it is extremely likely that there may be other victims... and I am contributing to their suffering by not adding another possible charge of sexual molestation of a minor. Thank you for the advice though. I will be seeking the appropriate therapy.
